title: Account Executive
description:
Key Responsibilities & Skills Preparation of all types of sales invoices , including material and service invoices. Reconciliation of Bank, Debtors, Head Office, and Branch Office statements. Timely reminder and follow-up of pending payments. Assisting in accounts maintenance and financial record keeping . Ledger scrutiny, accounting, and book writing . Handling purchase and sales order processing . Preparation of monthly cheque debtors and creditors lists . Maintaining vouchers for Sales, Purchase, Journal, Receipt, and Payment transactions. Daily monitoring and follow-up of Debtors and Creditors . Timely payment of GST and TDS and preparation of related returns. Working knowledge of Stock Statement Strong organizational and management skills with a hardworking and dedicated approach. Ability to work independently as well as effectively within a team environment

Key Skills: Accounting,Ledger,Reconciliation,TDS,Hard Working,GST,Sales Invoice,Bank Reconciliation
